code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: checkout-db-credentials
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DB_USERNAME: "checkout_svc"
  DB_PASSWORD: "N0rthbr1dge-Pr0d!"
caption: stringData takes plain text and Kubernetes base64-encodes it for storage — type: Opaque is the generic default.

eyebrow: The one thing that matters most

steps.label: Reversible instantly
steps.sub: base64 -d recovers the real value with one command

steps.label: Not encrypted by default
steps.sub: etcd stores it in plain base64 unless you configure encryption at rest

steps.label: Lock down with RBAC
steps.sub: and consider an external secret manager for high-value data

code:
spec:
  containers:
    - name: checkout
      env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: checkout-db-credentials
              key: DB_PASSWORD
caption: Same env/volume pattern as a ConfigMap — secretKeyRef instead of configMapKeyRef.

subtitle: Giving storage a life beyond the Pod it started in.
